name: SUZ12 polycomb repressive complex 2 subunit
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: SUZ12 encodes polycomb protein SUZ12. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor binding and enzyme activator activity. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and heterochromatin formation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Imagawa-Matsumoto syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Endometrial stromal sarcoma; Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from Illumina. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: SUZ12 encodes polycomb protein SUZ12. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and heterochromatin formation. Functional annotations also associate the protein with transcription corepressor binding and enzyme activator activity.
